ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixel ratio across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, roughly elliptical white patches occupy the lateral sections of the lobes, separated by a dominant black central region. The borders between pigmentation zones are characterized by high-frequency mottling and pixel-level stippling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 72 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge with peak amplitudes reaching 12-20 pixels; specific jagged protrusions are most prominent on the distal portions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral margins tapering into sharp, well-defined fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single prominent circular ring-shaped scar located in the lower-central black region; several smaller white focal points distributed along the trailing edge serrations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible across the white pigmentation of both lobes, including a distinct horizontal rake mark on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular indentation/chip on the outer trailing edge of the left lobe; circular parasitic or attachment scar on the central peduncle-fluke junction.
other_distinctive_markers: The transition zone between the black central region and white lateral patches exhibits a unique feathered/speckled pixel pattern.
